open_leads.title: POSTECH second notice (20 Nov) on the Podium portal leak
open_leads.note: The event is still single_source (Dailysecu only). Read POSTECH's own notice or a second Korean publisher to corroborate it. Dailysecu names the 25,551-record system both as 대학통합포털(Podium) and as 대학업무포털, so check which it is.

notes: Story 2d2fded6 updates the existing single-source event: 25,551 more records (second notice of 20 Nov) bring the total to 45,529. Title, summary, plain, exec, action (now 'General advice:'), sources, evidence and validation were updated. The 19,978 figure is no longer in the summary, because the article read this run gives it only as a sum. The validator warns figure-no-evidence for 45,529: the page writes it as the Korean numeral 4만5,529, and the evidence quote has it word for word. The event goes back to second review.
